sn46.16:1.2: Then at that time the Fortunate One was afflicted, suffering, and very sick.
sn46.16:1.3: Then venerable Mahā Cunda, rising from seclusion in the evening time, approached the Fortunate One, and after approaching and worshipping the Fortunate One, he sat down on one side. While he was sitting on one side the Fortunate One said this to venerable Mahā Cunda:
sn46.16:1.4: “May the factors of Awakening occur to you, Cunda.”
sn46.16:2.1: “There are these seven factors of Awakening, reverend Sir, that have been fully explained by the Fortunate One, when developed and made much of they lead to deep knowledge, Complete Awakening, and Nibbāna.
sn46.16:2.4: These are the seven factors of Awakening, reverend Sir, which have been fully explained by the Fortunate One, when developed and made much of they lead to deep knowledge, Complete Awakening, and Nibbāna.”
sn46.16:2.5: “Surely, Cunda, (these are) the factors of Awakening!
sn46.16:2.6: Surely, Cunda, (these are) the factors of Awakening!”
sn46.16:3.2: and the Teacher was in agreement,
sn46.16:3.3: and the Fortunate One recovered from that affliction,
sn46.16:3.4: and by that the Fortunate One’s affliction was brought to an end.
